n859550a0dd.headline: First Carbon Capture and Storage Project in Japan Now Enters its Planning Stage
n859550a0dd.summary: Eneos Holdings and J-Power, a Japanese utility, plan to build the country's first permanent carbon capture and storage facility by the end of this decade, the companies said Tuesday.
n859550a0dd.why: Eneos is one of Japan's largest energy and resources groups, and J-Power is a major electric utility, so their project signals how Japanese energy firms are approaching decarbonisation.

n9cac4f573f.headline: India bans exports of wheat, citing threat to food security
n9cac4f573f.summary: India has banned wheat exports with immediate effect, citing a threat to its food security. The government pointed partly to the war in Ukraine.
n9cac4f573f.why: India is a major wheat producer, and export restrictions tighten global grain supply and push up world wheat prices.
n9cac4f573f.why_moved: India banned wheat exports with immediate effect over food security concerns, partly linked to the war in Ukraine, cutting supply from a major exporter.

n9dede39c33.headline: Indian edible oil importers see 'ugly' supply crunch if Indonesia ban continues
n9dede39c33.summary: Indian vegetable oil importers predict a severe supply crunch if Indonesia continues its ban on palm oil exports to meet domestic demand.
n9dede39c33.why: Indonesia is a top global palm oil producer; export restrictions can tighten global edible oil supplies, impacting prices and inflation in importing countries like India.
n9dede39c33.why_moved: The export ban reduces global palm oil supply, pushing prices higher and threatening supply chains in major importing countries like India.

n84a67b234c.headline: Dollar less than $50 from surpassing historic highs
n84a67b234c.summary: The Colombian peso's Market Representative Rate reached 4,110.53 pesos per dollar, a level not seen in over two years.
n84a67b234c.why: Currency depreciation affects import costs, inflation, and foreign investment flows in Colombia.
n84a67b234c.why_moved: The peso's decline reflects market pressures and affects inflation and investment in Colombia.

n1bcfc9fe99.headline: China, US compete in greeting Marcos
n1bcfc9fe99.summary: The US and China are competing for influence as they recognize Ferdinand Marcos Jr. as the Philippine president-elect.
n1bcfc9fe99.why: Great-power rivalry affects diplomatic and economic relations in Southeast Asia, impacting regional stability and investment climate.

n3060608db1.headline: Solsky warns of global food crisis due to Russia – UN predicts death of millions
n3060608db1.summary: A Ukrainian official warned of a global food crisis caused by Russia, with hunger expected to hit Asia and Africa first. The UN has predicted deaths of millions.
n3060608db1.why: Disruption to grain and fertilizer exports from Russia and Ukraine feeds directly into global wheat and food prices.

n92d4091d20.headline: IMEF forecasts inflation of 8% at year end
n92d4091d20.summary: Mexico's IMEF business association forecasts inflation of 8% at the end of the year. The projection points to continued price pressure in the Mexican economy.
n92d4091d20.why: Inflation forecasts shape expectations for the central bank's interest rate path, which affects bonds and the peso.

na1d7306ff1.headline: Price of Azerbaijani oil exceeds $117
na1d7306ff1.summary: The price of Azerbaijan's light oil was $117.25 per barrel on a CIF basis at Italy's Augusta port on May 13, according to the report.
na1d7306ff1.why: Azerbaijan's Azeri Light is a benchmark crude grade for Mediterranean and European refining, so its price reflects regional oil markets.

n34e8063286.headline: Electricity price will fall 5.64% this Saturday and again drop below 200 euros/MWh - Crónica de Cantabria
n34e8063286.summary: The average Spanish wholesale electricity price will fall 5.64% on Saturday versus Friday, dropping again below 200 euros per MWh. The pool average is set on the day-ahead market.
n34e8063286.why: Spain's wholesale power pool sets electricity prices for the market, which feeds into energy costs for industry and households.

n71d8df756a.headline: Russia-Ukraine war causes wheat prices to rise; government makes major export decision
n71d8df756a.summary: India's government has banned wheat exports due to rising domestic and international prices, affecting global wheat markets.
n71d8df756a.why: India is a major wheat exporter; export bans can influence global wheat prices and supply stability.
n71d8df756a.why_moved: The export ban limits wheat supply, causing prices to rise globally, impacting food markets and inflation.
